title: SummarySchema
description: Final output contract for the Synthesis stage. Machine-readable form of the meeting summary; the human-readable form is summary.md.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this summary was generated.

overall_summary.description: 2–5 sentence high-level narrative of the meeting.

per_slide_summaries.description: One entry per aligned segment (slide or general discussion), in time order.

action_items.description: Action items extracted from across the full meeting. Empty array if none identified.

decisions.description: Key decisions recorded during the meeting. Empty array if none identified.

slide_id.description: Matches slide_id in SlideTimelineSchema. Null for general discussion sections.

slide_title.description: Slide title or 'General Discussion' for unanchored segments.

summary.description: 2–4 sentence summary of the discussion during this slide.

key_points.description: Notable statements, facts, or conclusions from this slide's discussion.
